recap.analyst:
Ridgeview beat Montaña CF 2-1. On expected goals it finished 0.79–0.08: Ridgeview created the better chances and the result reflects it.

Montaña CF had 57% of the ball. Pass completion RID 76% (115/152), MON 84% (187/222). Shots 8–1, on target 2–1.

Ridgeview started in a 4-2-3-1 (direct), Montaña CF in a 5-4-1 (direct). In-game changes: MON to 3-4-3 at 66' (chasing the game); RID to 4-4-2 at 80' (protecting the lead).

Turning point, 42': Ridgeview broke the deadlock through S. Toure. The chance was worth xG 0.04 (about 4 in 100 go in), struck at 79 km/h. Score now RID 1-0 MON. It proved to be the winner.

By the numbers: R. Guerreiro completed the most passes (36); T. Arbeloa hit the top speed (33.5 km/h); N. Fofana covered the most ground (6.33 km, a 17.8 km per-90 pace); T. Arbeloa won the most challenges (11).

Discipline: fouls 3–2, yellows 0–1, offsides 0–0. Conditions: sunny, 24°C, pitch dry, firm.
recap.fan: A tense, tight night at Castellana Arena, Madrid. S. Toure broke the deadlock in the 42nd minute. P. Petit struck in the 51st for Ridgeview. Z. Yilmaz struck in the 93rd for Montaña CF. Montaña CF pushed for a way back, switching to a 3-4-3 in the 66th minute, but Ridgeview held firm. The hero: S. Toure, with the goal that mattered. At the final whistle, Ridgeview celebrate in front of their fans.
